# Simple Dev Tools

Simple Dev Tools is a set of browser dev tools I built at Hello.World Consulting. You can turn requests into API snippets, edit Mermaid diagrams, run SQLite queries, test regex, format JSON, check schemas and JWTs, convert timestamps, test color contrast, diff text, hash files, preview Markdown, edit query strings, and generate IDs or QR codes without logging in or sending data to a server.

You open a tool, paste your stuff in, grab the result, and close the tab. None of it goes to a backend.

## Data Boundaries

- Every tool runs directly in your browser.
- There are no user accounts and no server database saving your inputs.
- Some tools rely on built-in browser APIs, local WebAssembly, or bundled client libraries.
- Even with everything running locally, keep real production secrets, private keys, customer records, and regulated data out of public web tools unless your own policy allows it.

## Tools

- [API Snippet Generator](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/api-snippet/): Turn one endpoint, method, headers, bearer token, and JSON body into cURL, Python requests, and JS fetch code.
- [Mermaid Editor](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/mermaid/): Edit flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and architecture sketches with live preview and SVG or PNG export.
- [SQLite Playground](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/sqlite/): Run SQL against a temporary in-memory SQLite database via sql.js WASM, inspect result tables, and export CSV or JSON.
- [Regex Lab](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/regex/): Test JavaScript regular expressions with live matches, replacements, sample text, and shareable links.
- [IDs & Scheduling](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/ids-cron/): Generate UUIDs and ULIDs, pull timestamps out of ULIDs, and decode cron lines into plain English.
- [Encoders & QR](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/encode-qr/): Encode or decode Base64 and URLs, or generate PNG and SVG QR codes.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/timestamp/): Convert Unix timestamps in seconds or milliseconds, ISO 8601 dates, and time zones with relative time.
- [JSON Workbench](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/json/): Format, minify, check, and convert JSON, YAML, and CSV, sort keys, and query values by path.
- [Color & Contrast](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/color/): Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH, build tints and shades, and check WCAG contrast ratios.
- [Text Diff](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/diff/): Compare two blocks of text side by side or inline with word highlights and copy or export buttons.
- [File Hash Checker](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/hash/): Hash text or dropped files with SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 and check them against an expected digest.
- [Markdown Preview](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/markdown/): Write or paste Markdown for a sanitized live preview, then copy or download the clean HTML.
- [Querystring Editor](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/query/): Break URL query strings and form bodies into a table, edit them, and copy the encoded output back.

## Studios

- [Schema & Types Studio](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/studio/schema/): Read JSON Schema, YAML, or OpenAPI specs, validate payloads, generate TypeScript interfaces or Zod schemas, and read rendered OpenAPI docs.
- [Security & Tokens](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/studio/security/): Decode and verify JWTs, sign new tokens, hash text, and generate HMACs with Web Crypto.

## Technical Docs

## Policies

- [robots.txt](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/robots.txt): The machine-readable policy. Defaults are search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no, and use=reference, with an exception for Google-Extended. If anything here differs, robots.txt wins.
- **Search indexing: allowed.** Crawlers can index this site and show links and short excerpts in search results.
- **AI answers and grounding: allowed.** Pages can be fetched at answer time to ground AI answers, summaries, or citations as long as they link back to the source page.
- **AI training: Google-Extended exception.** Google can use this content for Gemini Apps, Vertex AI grounding, and Gemini model training. Other crawlers may not train or fine-tune models on it or build a training corpus from it. This is an express reservation of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790.
